project_info.theme: Dark Tactical High-Contrast (with theme toggle support)

layout_and_grids.card_style: bg-[#131C2E] border border-[#23314A] rounded-xl p-5 shadow-lg shadow-black/20 hover:border-[#3B82F6]/40 transition-all duration-200

key_modules.login_page: High density dark tactical login view with JWT auth simulation, company name APR MENSUR DULJEVIĆ, admin role badge, and credential toggles.
key_modules.dashboard: Key metrics summary shelf: Ukupno Vozila, Istekle Dokumentacije (Red Badge), Ističu Uskoro (Yellow Badge), Aktivni Servisi, Ukupni Troškovi Održavanja (RSD). Visual alert table for 6-month inspection, 12-month registration, CMR insurance, Kasko insurance.
key_modules.vehicle_list: Comprehensive table & grid view with quick filters by document status (Crveno, Žuto, Zeleno), registration plate, model, vehicle type, and quick action buttons.
key_modules.vehicle_detail: Individual vehicle view with documentation status cards (6-mesečni tehnički pregled, 12-mesečna registracija, CMR osiguranje, Kasko osiguranje), interactive renewal drawer/modal, and maintenance history timeline.
key_modules.maintenance_log: Evidencija održavanja - detailed logs of repairs, oil changes, tire replacement, parts cost in RSD, mechanic notes, service status, and add new service entry.
key_modules.reports_view: Izveštaji & Štampa - preview formatted official document for APR MENSUR DULJEVIĆ fleet status, print view button (CSS print stylesheet optimized), and Export to Word (.docx) functionality.

testing_requirements.data_testid_policy: All buttons, inputs, filter options, status badges, rows, and export buttons MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure language is strictly Serbian Latin script throughout the interface (e.g. Registracija, Tehnički pregled, CMR osiguranje, Kasko osiguranje, Održavanje, Izveštaji, Štampa, Izvoz u Word).
Display all costs and monetary values in Serbian Dinar (RSD) formatted with Serbian grouping (e.g. 120.000 RSD).
Incorporate clear red and yellow warning badges on cards, tables, and top alert banners for documents expiring within 30 days (yellow) or already expired (red).
Provide full Word (.docx) export mechanism and Print view layout optimized with @media print CSS rules.
Use Lucide React icons for tactical dashboard elements (Truck, AlertTriangle, Shield, Wrench, FileText, Calendar, Printer, Download, CheckCircle, Search, Plus).
Add toast notifications via Sonner for document renewals, service creation, export confirmation, and login actions.
